role: sample-only authored whole-body cephalopod display replacements
authorship: Original procedural geometry and vertex colour code authored in this project. Reference pages supply natural-history facts only; no external image, texture or mesh has been copied.

species.unitDefinition: Outer mantle X extent is one unit, from -0.5 to +0.5. Head, eight arms and two feeding tentacles additionally enter the complete motion envelope.
species.wholeForm: Broad flattened closed mantle, narrower head with lateral W-shaped pupils, two continuous mantle fin fringes, eight volume-tapered arms and two slender feeding shafts ending in clubs.

sources.supports: Coral reef habitat, flattened hovering body, eight arms plus two feeding tentacles and a delicate moving fin fringe.
Rounded mantle relative to squid; nearly encircling mantle fin, eight arms, two feeding tentacles and anterior lateral eyes.

species.unitDefinition: The complete horizontal arm diameter is at most one unit. No mantle-size-to-total-length conversion or catalogue resizing is performed.
species.wholeForm: Low elongated muscular mantle and head, lateral slit pupils, interbrachial web and eight continuous tapered radial arms with short curled tips and paired underside cup suggestions.

sources.supports: Head, mantle and eight muscular arms with webbing; brown and tan mottled day octopus inhabits shallow reef and hunts during the day.
Octopus cyanea, Indo-Pacific reefs, daytime foraging and variable mottled textured camouflage.

motion: Deterministic bounded arm yaw/lift and fin-group flex; shared per-species template pose suitable for the existing instance matrix renderer. The small sucker cup field is a visual suggestion rather than complete biological population.
limitations: These are authored representative forms, not scans, photographs, measured anatomy or a claim of documentary realism.
No full skin camouflage, ink, prey capture, fluid simulation, jet propulsion or muscular biomechanics are implemented.
Arm lifts stay above the local display base; actual substrate support is supplied by the sample's complete physical envelope, not per-sucker surface conformation.
Whole-form and motion bounds are native geometry checks; local WebGL appearance and frame rate require separate review.
